notes: 'The wise men' is an anarthrous substantival adjective under rule 46, headed on 'wise' by rule 31's subtraction.
הֹבִישׁוּ → 'are put to shame' heads on the complement, which is rule 44's own named case for בּוֹשׁ.
בִדְבַר־יְהוָה מָאָסוּ is rule 40's promoted object, so the בְּ is unrepresented while the chain takes 'the word of Jehovah'.
חָכְמַת מֶה → 'what manner of wisdom' gives the relational 'of' to the rectum under rule 19, with the competing reading recorded in the unit note; the לְ predicate takes the copula under rule 49.
